payload.title: Correlations at Sea
payload.description: This notebook explores the complexities of correlation analysis in paleoclimate studies, focusing on the pitfalls of persistence, time irregularities, age uncertainties, and multiple hypothesis testing. It reproduces a study by Hu et al. (2017) to demonstrate these issues using a paleoclimate record and sea-surface temperature data. The notebook employs various statistical techniques to assess the significance of correlations, considering the challenges posed by data characteristics and uncertainties.
